notes.title: The Time to Grow is Here! Growmancer Full Release
notes.content: [p]It's finally here! Growmancer has now fully launched and is ready for you to play.[/p][p]We can't wait to see what you think. If you enjoy your time with the game, please consider leaving a review. It helps more players like you discover Growmancer![/p][p]Enjoy the game![/p][p]P.S. Shout-out to [url="https://youtu.be/zrpyzLq9asI?si=1ZNFFE4XHOWuL1ff"]Idle cub[/url] for the great idea in their video! As suggested, the pet can now get a cool firefighter helmet once you unlock the right upgrade. :)[/p][previewyoutube="zrpyzLq9asI;full"][/previewyoutube]
